cohort: 300 pregnant women in Turkey between May 16 and June 12, 2020
finding: Pregnant women's concerns about the COVID-19 pandemic were moderate and did not alter their delivery method preferences overall, although concerns were higher among those whose preferences changed.
mod_finding: The concerns of pregnant women who planned to perform their delivery by caesarean section before COVID-19 and whose delivery method preferences changed during the pandemic process were higher.
